rules.title: Rules
rules.lede: Instructions hiro follows on every ticket: global rules for all repositories and rules for one repository. Claude reviews each rule and asks about anything unclear before it applies.
rules.drawerSub: Write it the way you would brief a new teammate. Claude checks it before any ticket follows it.
rules.scopeHelp: Global rules apply in every repository. A repository rule wins where the two disagree.
rules.bodyPlaceholder: Every new HTTP endpoint gets an integration test next to its handler.
rules.bodyHelp: Say what to do, where, and what to do when it cannot be followed.
rules.rereviewHelp: You changed what the rule says, so Claude reviews it again. Tickets stop getting it until the review is done.
rules.savedReview: Rule saved; Claude is reviewing it
rules.none: No rules yet. Add one to tell hiro how your team works: testing, naming, logging, what never to touch.
rules.waitingHelp: {n, plural, one {# rule is waiting for your answers. It does not apply to tickets until it is answered.} other {# rules are waiting for your answers. They do not apply to tickets until they are answered.}}
rules.deleteBody: Delete the rule “{title}”? Tickets that start after this no longer follow it.
rules.pending: Waiting for a free worker. Claude reviews rules before the next ticket starts.
rules.analyzing: Claude is reading the rule and checking it for anything unclear or conflicting.
rules.questionsTitle: {n, plural, one {# question before this rule applies} other {# questions before this rule applies}}
rules.questionsSub: Claude found something unclear. Your answers become part of the rule.
rules.questionsLeft: {n, plural, one {# question left to answer} other {# questions left to answer}}
rules.acceptBody: Tickets get the rule as you wrote it, with the answers given so far. Open questions are dropped.
rules.failed: Claude could not review this rule: {error}
rules.answersTitle: {n, plural, one {# answered question} other {# answered questions}}
rules.answered: Answers sent; Claude is reviewing the rule again
